notes.title: Small Status Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

We would like to post a small update on what has been happening! Firstly, development is still happening, and testing has been pushed back late this year, or very early next year.

There is still not set date for Early Access release, but once the main game framework has been completed will be be updating the trailer and screenshots for the game so it is better represented.

We thank you for your patience, and don't forget to add Kings to your wishlist if you are excited for it!

Also, if you would like to join the Discord the link is here: https://discord.gg/cYvYsdg

Interactive Gaming Studios
